1import React from 'react'
2import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'
3import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'
4import { ReactQueryDevtools } from '@tanstack/react-query-devtools'
5import App from './App'
6 
7const queryClient = new QueryClient({
8  defaultOptions: {
9    queries: {
10      staleTime: 1000 * 60,
11      retry: 1,
12      throwOnError: true,
13    },
14    mutations: {
15      onError: (error) => {
16        console.error('Something went wrong:', error.message)
17      }
18    }
19  }
20})
21 
22createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(
23  <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
24    <App />
25    <ReactQueryDevtools />
26  </QueryClientProvider>
27)
